priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore removal of the registered message listener
findings.body: Calling the returned disposer no longer detaches `handler`. Any live socket continues invoking supposedly disposed handlers; repeated attach/dispose cycles retain closures, accumulate listeners, and duplicate message processing.

findings.title: [P2] Restore interval cancellation in the polling disposer
findings.body: The interval handle is discarded and the returned disposer does nothing. After cleanup, polling continues every second, retaining `refresh`; repeated lifecycle cycles accumulate timers, and in Node.js the active interval can prevent process termination.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:3 still returns a no-op disposer after registering handler with socket.on on line 2; the full diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler).
